factor.name: order_flow_v2_score
factor.description: 多尺度成交压力、冲击效率、吸收、状态一致性和流价背离的复合分数
factor.formula: mean(v2_flow_pressure, v2_execution_quality, v2_absorption_score, v2_regime_alignment, v2_divergence_score, v2_large_flow_score) with at least v2_min_component_count available components (2-6; default 3)
factor.missing_policy: invalid rows or fewer than the minimum available components remain NaN
factor.identity_limit: aggregated transaction proxies; does not identify accounts or institutions
